captions.text: Researchers have found that when you shift to a plant-based diet,
it has a much bigger effect in a variety of ways.
First of all, plants don't have much sodium. They've got potassium,
Secondly, they don't have a lot of fat,
and when you get the fat out of your diet, your blood changes.
It becomes more watery. It flows more easily.
So it's no surprise that Vegans have been shown to have really low blood pressure,
and it's a great way to reduce your blood pressure.
That said, if you're on blood pressure medicines, do not throw them away.
Work with your doctor to taper off your medicines if and when the time is right.
